topic: End-of-night git snapshot for Scourge redesign
currentUserGoal: Get the accumulated Grass Touching Simulator Scourge redesign work safely onto git before stopping for the night.
workCompleted: Reworked the redesign prototype toward the new Scourge loop: first-run objective gating, faster playtest pacing, wound pressure, real game-over flow, and Memory Grove meta progression.
Expanded Memory Grove into a dedicated post-run screen with old-skill-tree-inspired node layout, hover/focus details, purchase callouts, and functional memory upgrades.
Added DOM bridge controls and visible playtest tools so browser agents and accessibility tooling can inspect and drive the redesign without relying only on canvas pixels.
Improved readability by changing redesign renderer text handling, moving Options away from key information, hiding the persistent TOUCH ROOTS prompt, and giving the HUD more room for run tools.
Added Options work for separate music and SFX controls, plus procedural touch/heal/wound/purchase SFX through the existing AudioSystem.
Gated Dew Pulse, Root Salve, and Tiny Sprinkler so they are introduced during the run instead of cluttering the start state.
Updated core redesign docs and implementation plan to match the new mechanics and pacing decisions.
Saved the generated Scourge Update coming-soon poster under docs/artifacts so the promo mockup is not only a chat artifact.
verificationRun: npm run check passed on 2026-07-08: ESLint, 30 Vitest tests, TypeScript, and Vite production build.
Latest earlier browser smoke confirmed http://127.0.0.1:5173/?redesign&playtest returned HTTP 200.
The poster image was visually inspected after copying from the generated image cache.
knownIssues: The current redesign is still prototype-quality and needs another user playtest after the HUD/run-tool gating fix.
The user liked the SFX but has not yet confirmed that the Options sliders feel fully fixed in a fresh test.
The Memory Grove is closer to the old skill-tree charm, but still needs more polish, progression depth, and possibly old asset adaptation.
The coming-soon poster is a generated mockup and may need a second pass before public posting.
nextRecommendedSteps: After pulling this commit, test http://127.0.0.1:5173/?redesign&playtest with a hard refresh.
Confirm start-of-run HUD has no Dew Pulse, Root Salve, or Tiny Sprinkler buttons until relevant.
Play through game over into Memory Grove and verify skills with exact-cost purchases work.
Polish Options sliders and SFX volume feel if the next playtest still shows rough edges.
Continue restoring cute old-game visual charm while keeping the new Scourge mechanics.
doNotRevert: Do not bring the old clicker/automation gameplay back as the primary loop; the redesign branch is intentionally rebuilding around Scourge pressure, wounds, runs, and Memory Grove progression.
Keep the graphical tone and old assets as inspiration; the user wants the cute original vibe rebuilt into the new mechanics.
Keep DOM-accessible controls and state because the user liked the AI-agent-accessibility suggestion.
Keep SFX work intact; the user specifically said the sound effects are pretty nice.
